description: This file defines the 'Voucher' class within the OpenCart API, specifically for handling voucher-related API endpoints such as applying, adding, and removing vouchers. It includes methods for processing requests, validating input, and generating JSON responses.

classes.name: Voucher
classes.description: Controller class for managing voucher-related API actions including applying, adding, and removing vouchers in the OpenCart system.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles the application of a voucher. Loads language, retrieves voucher code from POST request, validates it, and sets session data with the voucher if valid, returning a JSON response.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Creates a new voucher with provided details. Validates input fields, generates a voucher code, updates session and returns success or error JSON.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a voucher from the session by key, used for deleting vouchers from the cart or voucher list.
